chaosCarRain_trigger.title: Chaos Car Rain: Drop a Car!
chaosCarRain_trigger.desc: Drops a random vehicle out of the sky near you
chaosCarRain_trigger.onDown: if not extensions.isExtensionLoaded('chaosCarRain') then extensions.load('chaosCarRain') end extensions.chaosCarRain.trigger()

chaosCarRain_increaseCooldown.title: Chaos Car Rain: Increase Cooldown
chaosCarRain_increaseCooldown.desc: Raises the Chaos Car Rain cooldown by one step (default 1s)

chaosCarRain_decreaseCooldown.title: Chaos Car Rain: Decrease Cooldown
chaosCarRain_decreaseCooldown.desc: Lowers the Chaos Car Rain cooldown by one step (default 1s)
